notes: Attempt 2. The critical defect from attempt 1 is fixed: the small right-hand watch/fob pocket is now rendered, and a 3x magnified crop confirms it is a genuine narrow single-jetted welt, straight and horizontal, sitting directly under the waistband on the right front, inboard of the right-hand belt loop — exactly where the drawing puts the short red bar. Measured against the drawing, the welt-to-besom length ratio is about 0.47 versus about 0.46 in the illustration. The besom on the far hip, the slant opening on the near side, the belt loops and the crease are all preserved from attempt 1 and still match the drawing. No red or annotation leaked into the cloth. Two minor findings remain: the welt sits a fraction below the waistband seam instead of flush against it, and the bottom of the frame still carries empty leg. Neither obscures or misstates the construction.
